PROFESSIONAL PROFILE

Dr. Shaker Adam Idrees

Medical Doctor · Emergency Medicine · Occupational Medicine · Public Health

Medical doctor with experience in emergency medicine, occupational medicine and public health across Sudan, Libya and Saudi Arabia since graduating in 2009. His CV records emergency and outpatient care, occupational health assessments, disease prevention, health promotion and healthcare quality improvement within government and multicultural healthcare systems.
